card.name: Study size before counts in trial summaries
card.fires_on: Words or digits that come right before a number of studies or patients in a summary of trials or a meta-analysis, such as 'of' before 17 studies or 'in' before 4400 patients. Also the opening bracket after a long study title.

modes.label: Before study or patient counts
modes.description: The marked spot sits just ahead of a count of studies or participants in a meta-analysis or trial pool.
modes.example: A meta-analysis of<< >>17 prospective and 35 retrospective

modes.label: Inside the number
modes.description: The first digits of a count of studies are marked.
modes.example: A meta-analysis of 1<<7>> prospective and 35 retrospective epidemiology

modes.label: Before patient totals
modes.description: A small word comes just before the total number of patients.
modes.example: 24 short-term trials of 9 antidepressant drugs<< in>> over 4400 patients.

card.writes: It seems to push toward known quantities and away from words for unknown or unsure, so a definite number is expected next.
card.plain: It fires where a study summary is about to give how many studies or patients were included.
